summary: San Bernardino NF lookout built 1925 on Grass Valley Ridge; snow brought it down in January 1933 and a new tower at Strawberry Peak replaced it. Exact site unknown.

facts.design: 80-foot tower with an 8x8 cabin that appears to be wood; the register says steel X-brace, a 1925 item says lumber
facts.status_note: Collapsed under snow in January 1933; no source describes what remains at the site.
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, San Bernardino National Forest

events.note: Built by Forest Service cooperators; the register gives 1925
Second lookout posted in August 1931, so two people watched the district
Collapsed under snow in a January 1933 storm; the register says destroyed in a storm and heavy snow load
Forest officials planned a new site; a tower at Strawberry Peak, to the south, replaced it
The register gives 1935 as the removal year; not explained by the 1933 collapse reports

notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the FFLOS register and a Forest Lookouts compilation of 1925-1933 newspaper items. Construction conflicts: register says steel X-brace, 1925 item says lumber; both kept in the story. The register's 1935 removal date is not explained by the 1933 collapse reports. The register still gives a point (34.259553, -117.232146) beside its own note that the exact location is unknown; treat the point as approximate. The brief's access 'unknown' is not confirmed by any source, so no access fact is written. One WebSearch returned aggregator text on the collapse cause and a different 1925 date; it is not used. The Strawberry Peak lookout is a separate, later tower and was not researched. No new photos found.
